articleTitle: SiC Power Devices and Application to Power Electronics
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: Power electronics technologies play important roles in driving energy conservation and low carbonization, where power devices are key components that support power electronics for efficient use of energy and are indispensable for power supply and control. In the paper, the market trend of power semiconductor devices is overviewed. Then state-of-the-art SiC power devices, such as SiC-MOSFET and SiC-SBD are introduced. The paper also forecasts the requirements of power electronics equipment with utilization of SiC power devices.

articleTitle: Rotor Eccentricity Vibration Suppression Strategy for Multi-module Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: Rotor eccentricity is a common mechanical problem in motors. This paper proposes an eccentricity vibration suppression strategy for multi-module synchronous motors by reducing the unbalanced magnetic pull (UMP) caused by eccentricity. Analytical expressions of the UMP and optimal compensation currents under eccentricity conditions are deducted in this paper. Simulation verification implemented on a lowcoupling four-module motor indicates that, with the injection of the compensation winding currents, the eccentricity UMP can be approximately suppressed to zero without influencing the output torque.

articleTitle: High Ratio DC/DC Converter for Offshore Wind Farms with MVDC Collection System
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: Large-scale long-distance offshore wind farms with MVDC collection system are rapidly becoming a preferred choice for power transmission. The high ratio DC/DC converter to interconnect the MVDC collection and HVDC transmission systems remains the technical hurdle. It suffers large input current and high output voltage, as a result the semiconductors must be rated with the highest current and voltage stress. This paper proposes a new DC/DC converter topology, which is comprised of mature half-bridge submodule strings, low-cost series-connection diodes valves and thy-ristors valves. Alternatively, the strings are connected in parallel to share large current of MVDC, or in series to sustain high voltage of HVDC, resulting in high device utilization and conversion efficiency. The topology structure, operating princi-ple, and circuit design are discussed. The effectiveness of proposed converter is verified by simulation study of a 100MW 35kV/100kV system and experimental study of a 2.4kW 120V/360V scaled down prototype.

articleTitle: High-Performance Double Side Cooled Power Module for Auto-motive Traction Inverter Applications
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: High-performance Double Side Cooled (DSC) power modules based on trench Silicon Carbide (SiC) MOSFETs and Si IGBTs play a major role in automotive traction inverter applications; mainly in hybrid- and full-electric vehicles as the main inverter. To assure superior thermal performance and consequently high current density thermal stack optimization should be done. The switching and thermal characteristics of modules with Si IG-BTs and SiC MOSFETs are compared in this pa-per to demonstrate the differences.

articleTitle: Cable Stray Parameters Impact Exploration on Stability of DC Distributed Power System
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: The profound impact of cable stray parameters on the stability of DC distributed power systems (DPS) in ships and buildings is challenging to comprehend and results in system stability deterioration. However, the issue has not been widely reported. This paper features a disruptive RLC model and reveals that cable stray inductance dictates the system resonance frequency, which amends the subunit's equivalent resistance and influences the system damping. The developed model is innovative and more intuitive than conventional methods ensuring 95% accuracy, verified against experimental results and eigenvalue analysis. This research offers key insights to ensure robust and resilient system operation.

articleTitle: The new CIPOS(TM) Micro intelligent power module with reverse conducting IGBT technology for home appliances
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper introduces a new family of intelligent power modules (IPMs) available in two different packages. These IPMs integrate the secondgeneration reverse-conducting drive IGBT (RC-D IGBT) technology with the junctionisolated gate driver for use in high efficiency motor drives such as fans and pumps. This new RC-D IGBT technology offers higher current density and lesser power losses, making it the optimal technology for compact power modules. The new advanced IPMs are available in both fast and slow speed variants, that incorporate protection features such as precise overcurrent protection and a temperature sensor. The fast and slow speeds enable low power loss and low electromagnetic interference (EMI) operation respectively depending on the end application’s requirement.

articleTitle: A novel low-cost, high efficiency, low-ripple high PF LED driver with ripple cancellation
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: The standards and regulations have increasingly stringent requirement for light quality, which requires lower LED ripple current driver. This paper proposes a low-ripple high PF LED driver scheme using ripple cancellation concept to shorten effective power processing paths for high efficiency. Unidirectional converter is adopted as ripple canceler to compensate large ripple current of PFC output for low-cost and simple control. With proposed voltage following circuit, the driver can achieve high efficiency during full LED load range. Prototype experiments verified that the proposed scheme realized the same current ripple as 2-stage driver; similar cost and efficiency as 1-stage driver.

articleTitle: Research on layout of paralleling LV100-type IGBT modules in three-level NPC converters
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: In recent years, with the development of power electronics technology, NPC three-level technology has been more and more applied in various fields, including photovoltaic inverters, wind power converters, UPS, APF, high-frequency power supply, etc. Meanwhile, the demand for inverters incorporating large-capacity IGBT modules has increased in line with the growing use of renewable energy. In order to apply high voltage, NPC (Neutral Point Clamped) three-level circuit is commonly used. Meanwhile, the power rating of inverters is getting larger and larger, so IGBT paralleling is inevitable. The current sharing is a design difficulty. LV100-package is a newly developed IGBT package. It has compact volume and lower internal stray inductance. This paper will discuss two layouts for LV100-type IGBT modules. The simulation and experiments were done to compare the current balance and commutation loop stray inductance.

articleTitle: The 7th Generation “X Series” Intelligent Power Module and Its Feature
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper introduces the 7th-gen X series Intelligent Power Module (X-IPM) and its feature. Fuji Electric has developed the X-IPM for industrial applications, which achieves further miniaturization and performance improvement of power conversion systems by adopting the newly developed power chip and control IC. The newly developed control IC (X-Series IC) integrates various unique functions. For instance, the X-IPM comes with the industry’s first warning output function and the temperature-based power dissipation reduction function. Furthermore, the accuracy of the IGBT chip overheat protection built into the X-IPM has also been improved in order to achieve higher temperature operation. By applying these technologies, the X-IPM will contribute to improving the performance of power conversion systems.

articleTitle: Research on Source Network Load Storage Collaborative control Based on multi port power electronic transformer in Coal Mine
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: In order to meet the energy consumption optimization of intelligent coal mine construction and the power quality problems caused by the largescale underground mining equipment, the coal mine distribution network needs to be transformed. The collaborative control method based on multiport power electronic transformer is adopted to meet the power generation and power consumption needs in the source and load, and achieve the purpose of using the renewable energy, reducing transmission line loss, and improving mining efficiency.

articleTitle: Introduction of Large DIPIPM+(TM) application on air-conditioner inverters
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper presents an overview of Large DIPIPM+(TM) transfer-mold intelligent power modules. The first part of this paper discusses innovative features of this series product, also the advantages of Large DIPIPM+(TM) are summarized. Next, since Large DIPIPM+ modules have been used in the commercial multi-compressors air-condition systems, some technical details, including testing items and results are reviewed during the project development phase. In the third part, it is concluded that Large DIPIPM+(TM) realizes simpler and more compact designs for inverter systems, as well as highly efficient inverter operation and miniaturization of the overall PCB size.

articleTitle: Design for "E+E" Type Magnetic Integrated Transformers in 2-Phase Parallel LLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper proposes an "E+E" type magnetic integrated transformer for two-phase parallel LLC resonant converter. By analyzing the problems such as more eddy current loss of the windings near the air gap in traditional "EE" type magnetic integrated transformer, this paper proposes a new "E+E" type magnetic integrated transformer structure, establishes its circuit and magnetic circuit model, and completes its parameter design. The electromagnetic field simulation comparison between the new "E+E" type and the traditional "EE" type magnetic integrated transformers is carried out, and the two types of transformers’ experimental prototypes are made. The main circuit and control circuit of the two-phase parallel LLC resonant converters are designed, and the experimental platform is set up. It can be seen that the two-phase parallel LLC resonant converter has higher efficiency with the new “E+E” type magnetic integrated transformer than with the traditional "EE" ones.

articleTitle: Thermal Evaluation of SiC MOSFET Power Modules with HPD Package and Double-sided Cooling Package
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper aims to compare the thermal performance between a conventional HPD package and a double-sided cooling (DSC) package of SiC MOSFET power module. An electro-thermal analysis was studied and experiments were conducted to evaluate their capability of current conduction. To understand the failure of DSC module, the matching of heatsinks and a module at interfaces was studied. A conceptual DSC module with pinfin heatsink is proposed.

articleTitle: Transient optimal control algorithm for DC-DC converter based on time-series neural network
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive predictive correction control method for DC-DC converters based on time series neural network is proposed. The method utilizes the time-series network to identify and predict the output voltage of the converter in the transient process, and compensates and corrects the reference value of the controller, thereby realizing the adaptive control of the converter. In this paper, the NAR model and the NARX model are used to simulate and verify the method. The results show that, compared with the traditional PI control, the method can effectively suppress the voltage fluctuation in the transient process, significantly shorten the adjustment time of the converter, and is expected to be applied in high-performance regulated power supplies.

articleTitle: The effect of quasi-DC power cycling on insulated gate bipolar transistor dual-in-line package intelligent power module
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper presents an experimental study on the effect of wide temperature swing on the reliability of small capacity Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT) Dual In-line Package Intelligent Power Modules (DIPIPMs) often utilized in Electric Vehicle (EV) and Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) air-conditioner inverter drive application. The power modules were cycled using quasi-DC power cycling, also known as Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) controlled DC power cycling. Test samples were power cycled until the end-of-life was reached. Collector-emitter on-stage voltage drop (Vce,sat), junction temperature (Tj) and case themerature (Tcase) has been observed to study the degradation process. Furthermore, a visual inspection of the module was conducted using microscope camera, Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM), and x-ray.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Isolated DC-DC Converter With Wide Input Voltage Regulation Range
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This article proposes a hybrid isolated DC-DC (HIDC) converter with flexible control strategy. The HIDC converter is constructed by thyristors, modular multilevel arms at the MVDC side, and diodes at the LVDC side through transformer. The isolated structure of the converter can achieve high step-down ratio. Furthermore, by adjusting the duty cycle of submodule (SM) according to the input voltage, HIDC can ensure stable operation within a wide voltage range. Besides, the thyristor currents are controlled into three-phase staggered trapezoidal waves, so that the dc current is smooth without filter. The effectiveness is confirmed by simulation on a 500kW HIDC that converts 8~16kV to 750V.

articleTitle: Efficiency Improvement of a Nearly Zero Energy Building through the Optimal Control of the Domestic Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper studies the problem of the efficiency improvement in a nearly zero energy building (nZEB) by increasing the efficiency of the domestic wind turbine (WT). Since the cost of the equipment in a nZEB plays a key role, a WT with a squirrel cage induction generator (SCIG) is employed. The increase of the WT efficiency is attained through a minimum electric loss (MEL) controller for the SCIG that cooperates with a maximum point tracking controller (MPPT) that maximizes the output power of the WT. The MEL and the MPPT controllers determine the optimal d- and q-axis stator current components of the SCIG, respectively, through optimal conditions. Several experimental results are presented to validate the theoretical considerations and the effectiveness of the proposed optimal efficiency control system of a WY with SCIG.

articleTitle: Novel 2000 V IGBT with LV100 package for Renewable Energy Application
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: Recently in a power converter system using renewable energy sources, increasing output power capability by higher system operating voltage is being required with minimum hardware/software design effort. Considering the upper limit of operation voltage increase of DC1500 V by regulation of the low voltage directive, which is the evaluation standard for equipment safety, an IGBT module of a novel voltage class of 2000 V is proposed. The requirements from the renewable energy converter system such as high-capacity photovoltaics inverter (PVI) and wind power generator (WPG) are explained. Furthermore, power loss dissipation under assumed inverter operation conditions is particularly studied. Using prototyped water cooler dedicated for LV100 package structure, the thermal feasibility is verified.

articleTitle: 3.3kV All SiC Module for Traction Inverters with 2nd Generation Trench gate SiC MOSFETs
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: Recently a demand for further weight reduction and higher efficiency of traction inverters is increasing on our market. To achieve those requests, an enhancement of power density of power modules for traction applications is one of the keys to be successful. This paper describes the electrical characteristics of a newly developed 3.3kV All-SiC with the 2nd generation trench gate SiC-MOSFETs in a new high power package (HPnC), which is suitable for traction applications. This All-SiC module achieves more than twice the power density against a silicon version. In addition, Fuji’s 2nd generation trench gate SiC-MOSFETs enables eliminating SiC-SBDs, which allows further enhancement of power density.

articleTitle: DIPIPM Suitable for Middle Power Servo Drive
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper presents the latest 600V dual-in-line package intelligent power module (DIPIPM) which is suitable for middle power servo drivers. As one kind of motor control application, the servo driver requires higher carrier frequency, higher motor lock capacity and higher reliability than the general-purpose inverter (GPI). To achieve all these factors, DIPIPM is a good choice and is already accepted by worldwide servo makers. Large DIPIPM Ver.4/6 and mini DIPIPM Ver.7 were introduced and compared in this paper. Good performance and perfect protection functions make the new DIPIPM power modules easy to use.

articleTitle: Robust Model Predictive Current Control Based on Inductance Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: For model predictive control (MPC) strategy, the outstanding feature of MPC method is that control performance depends on the accuracy of model parameters. In order to improve the parameter robustness of MPC, this paper introduces an optimization strategy. Firstly, the influence of different model parameter mismatches in MPC method on control performance is analyzed. And it is proved that inductance and flux linkage have great influence on predictive control performance. Therefore, this paper introduces the corresponding improvement measure, in which, a flux linkage processing method is adopted to replace the flux linkage parameters in the prediction model with the resistance and inductance information. This means that the flux linkage is removed from the prediction model. Then, for the optimization of inductance parameters, the sliding mode observer is adopted to observe the inductance disturbance value, and the compensated inductance value is substituted into the current prediction model. Finally, the experiment results prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Resonance analysis and detection of the clustered grid-connected PV system
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: The resonance of the clustered grid-connection photovoltaic (PV) system is different from that of the traditional PV system. Resonant frequency of the latter is determined by the LCL filter parameters. Resonant frequency analysis of the former will be complicated which is affected by the resonant coupling of the other grid-connected inverters and the grid. In order to detect the resonance signal, this paper proposes a new method based on wavelet transform (WT) and Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT). Finally, the resonance signal is the harmonic whose amplitude is positive growth. Simulation and experimental results verify the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Degradation Mechanism of SiC MOSFET Module with Double Side Cooling for Electric Vehicle in Accelerated Aging Test
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: To investigate the role of packaging degradation and chip degradation of SiC MOSFET module with double side cooling (DSC), the customized DSC modules are aged by power cycling test for modelling the practical conditions. The parasitic resistance and thermal resistance are monitored as the indicator of health condition. The test results show that the gate of samples with defective sinter layers is damaged by high compressive stress, resulting in the shorter lifetime. Even though the lifetime of samples with healthy sinter layers is about 4~22 times than that of defective modules, the failure mode of them is VTH drift, rather than the sinter degradation.

articleTitle: Enhanced Master-Slave Windings Motor System with Extended Range of Applications
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: The master-slave windings motor compensates the torque ripple of the low carrier ratio system based on the principle of active filtering. Prediction and acquisition of voltage information of master windings that work in low carrier ratio is the key to realize torque compensation. The existing methods obtain relevant information through integrated control. To further improve the application range, this paper proposes an embedded master-slave windings system where the slave windings adaptively compensate the periodic torque ripple of the master windings. Exhaustive discussion on principle and control strategy is provided. Simulation and experimental results validate 76% improvement in the torque accuracy.

articleTitle: Short-circuit and overcurrent protection scheme of SiC MOSFET based on combined protection method
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This article aims at achieving a faster and more reliable short-circuit (SC) and overcurrent (OC) protection circuit integrated on the driver board of SiC MOSFETs. By combining classic desaturation protection methods with parasitic-inductancebased protection methods, it can achieve complementary advantages of protection circuits for SiC MOSFETs. This article firstly makes a review of present SC and OC protection methods, then raises a protection strategy with combined methods, which characteristics are mainly in the achievement of complementary advantages in response speed among different current rising rate. Finally, the feasibility of this scheme will be verified by experimental tests on a 1200V-300A SiC MOSFET power module.

articleTitle: Hardware Optimization of Current Distribution for Parallel-Connected, High-Power, Press-Pack IGBTs
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: IGBT modules are highly popular for high-power applications, but their finite current limit and expanding power requirements mean that methods for efficiently paralleling multiple modules is gaining attention. Press-Pack IGBT modules are ideal solutions for high-power applications, such as high-voltage DC and flexible AC transmission systems, due to their explosion-proof packaging, stable short-circuit failure mode, and their elimination of bond wires. However, accurate current sharing among paralleled IGBTs presents a significant challenge to the adoption of a parallel-module approach. To achieve balanced current distribution, optimization of the mechanical arrangement of parallel modules is critical. This work describes hardware optimization for Press-Pack paralleled IGBTs, and the results that can be obtained from correct mechanical layout. Power Integrations’ 1SP0340 single-channel SCALE(TM)-2 gate drivers are used for driving 4.5 kV IGBTs in parallel. Direct paralleling of IGBTs is supported by the 1SP0340 gate drivers. The P5000ZL45X202 and 5SMA 5000L450300 modules from Infineon Bipolar and Hitachi Energy are used to demonstrate performance.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of New Generation High Temperature Capacitor Films for Inverter Applications
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: Reliability of a new generation of capacitor films has been evaluated by means of life-testing for 2000 hours at 150deg C under voltage. The new films were developed for high heat capacitors suited for AC-DC inverter modules using SiC or GaN MOSFETS. The films could potentially reduce or eliminate active cooling. The films exhibit stable Dk (2.9), low Df (0.0017), and breakdown voltage of about 500 V/micrometer over the temperature range. Capacitors made with these films pass stringent industry reliability testing having <5% capacitance change, stable insulation resistance, and low dissipation losses over 2000 hours. The ultra-thin 3 & 5 micrometer films, made from a highheat engineering thermoplastic material, are compatible with existing downstream metallization, slitting and capacitor building technologies.

articleTitle: Suppressing Switching Noise Three-phase Inverter Enabling Output Voltage Control in Extended Output Range
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper describes a three-phase inverter which can extend the output voltage range. The inverter output voltage can be controlled even in the extended output range. Though the output range of the voltage source inverter is up to √3/2 times the power supply voltage, the inverter mentioned here can extend the output voltage range with fewer switch operating number. As for the inverter which expands the output voltage range with reduced switch operation number, the output voltage can not be controlled in the output extended area, but the output voltage control is made possible by improving switch control. The proposed method is also effective for noise regulation countermeasures because it can suppress the switching noise peak while reducing the number of switch operations.

articleTitle: A new voltage class 2.3 kV IGBT enables new solutions for 1500 VDC system
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: There are three main challenges for solar or energy storage systems (ESS) nowadays: reduce costs, increase efficiency, and increase power density compared with previous systems. Increasing system voltage can reduce wire loss, improve efficiency, and reduces the overall system costs at the same time. For these reasons, the 1500 V DC system is widely used in solar, energy storage system, and some other applications. The 1500 V DC systems require high-voltage system solutions with higher performance and reliability as compared to former 1000 V DC systems. Keeping this in mind, Infineon developed the new 2.3 kV voltage class IGBT modules, FF1800R23IE7 especially for 1500 V DC highpower applications such as the solar central inverter. To meet the requirements for high efficiency in solar or ESS applications, a new common collector module, FF2400RB12IP7 was also developed that can combine with the 2.3 kV module to form the NPC2 topology. This paper describes the solution based on this module, and a power stack was built to evaluate the performance of the 2.3 kV solution.

articleTitle: Infineon’s IGBT package evolution with regard to the development of 1500 V solar string inverters
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper summarizes the evolution of Infineon’s power module packages from EasyPACKTM 2B, EasyPACK(TM) 3B to EasyPACK(TM) 4B modules, used in 1500 V solar string inverters to achieve the highest power ratings. In particular the Easy- PACK(TM) 4B, a brand-new package has been proven to be the best-fit solution for the industry’s latest 320 kW 1500 V solar string inverter. The main trend in solar inverters is to reach higher power ratings. The EasyPACK(TM) 4B power module package has been developed based on this trend. This paper, as a summary of Infineon’s package portfolios used in solar string inverters, describes the characteristics of various IGBT packages that are key factors for optimal inverter solutions. Most importantly, this paper illustrates the new Infineon package for EasyPACK(TM) 4B from both the design and application perspective.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control for Open Winding PMSM Based on Optimizing Dead-Zone Effect
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: In order to improve the steady-state performance of open winding permanent magnet synchronous motor (OW-PMSM) with common dc bus in conventional single-vector model predictive control (CSMPC), a model predictive control based on optimizing dead-zone effect is put forward. First, dead-zone effect in CSMPC is analysed. Then, the model predictive control based on optimizing dead-zone effect is put forward where the applied time of dead-zone voltage vector (DVV) is variable. Finally, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation Validation of Boost Inverter Switching Losses
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper analyses and discusses the boost inverter's performance in reducing switching losses by using the 240deg-clamped space vector pulse width modulation (PWM) called 240CPWM. 240CPWM is a proposed modulation used to boost inverter because it can improve the efficiency of the whole system and reduce the switching losses by clamping a phase to the positive or negative rail for 240deg. Always only one out of the three phases are switched. The theoretical considerations are finally verified on simulation, where the proposed modulation 240CPWM is experimentally compared with the conventional spatial vector PWM (CSVPWM) under different operating conditions. The different operating conditions are used to simulate the different driving cycles of the electric vehicle (EV).

articleTitle: Equalizing the voltage of ANPC topology switches
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: ANPC topology is more and more popular in solar application. ANPC structure compared to NPC because of two additional switches and corresponding two neutral points commutation circuit, it can be more flexible and arbitrary configuration of the switches can make the loss is balanced. Solar inverter cooling system will be turned off when the power is low such as 100kW, which will lead to a decrease in heat dissipation capacity, when the temperature of different chips will be different, which will lead to uneven voltage distribution problems. This paper will explain how differences in chip temperature can lead to voltage imbalance, while consider the solutions to equalize the voltage.

articleTitle: A New Generation of 600V CIPOS(TM) Tiny IM323 Intelligent Power Module for Home Appliance Motor Drive Application
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper presents a new generation of 600 V 15 A CIPOS(TM) (control integrated power system) Tiny IM323 IPM (intelligent power module) product in a DIL (dual in-line) package with transfer molded type. It combines the features of Infineon TRENCHSTOP(TM) RC-D2 (reverse conducting for drives) IGBTs and optimized SOI (silicon on insulator) gate driver to achieve an excellent solution for up to 1.5 kW motor drive applications. Especially, this module offers the smallest package size with high power density. This paper provides an overall description of the new 600 V 15 A CIPOS(TM) Tiny IM323 product along with its electrical characteristics, thermal performance, adopted revers conducting IGBTs, and SOI gate driver.

articleTitle: Programmable Gate Driver Solution with Optimized Two-Level Turn-Off for Paralleled IGBTs in Renewable Energy Application
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper presents a programmable gate driver solution for renewable energy applications. From the hardware structure perspective, the solution consists of two parts. The first part is an Intelligent Main Control unit (IMC) that employs an onboard FPGA. The main function of the IMC is to receive the signal from the system controller and return feedback information on IGBT temperature, UVLO and short-circuit. The second part of the assembly is the Module Adapted Gate Driver unit (MAG). The MAG board is dedicated to a unique IGBT module package (such as the popular 17 mm IGBT package) and employs SCALE(TM)-2 technology to optimize the switching behavior of the IGBT, especially for paralleled IGBT applications. A two-level turn-off function is included, which limits collector-emitter voltage caused by large stray inductances in the collector path during a turn-off event. The performance of two-level turn-off is compared to other overvoltage protection methods.

articleTitle: Optimized design of unified platform for light industrial applications using SiC MOSFETs and mixed DC-link capacitors
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: A unified platform for single- and 3-phase AC input for light industrial applications is feasible by using SiC MOSFETs and diodes in power factor correction (PFC) stage in order to keep the DC-link voltage constantly at 540 V. System output power can be increased from 5.25 kW for commercial fridge inverter applications to 7 kW for commercial air-conditioning applications with single-phase input, by changing the PFC SiC MOSFET with RDS(on) from 30 mOmega to 14 mOmega. The combination of paralleled electrolytic capacitors and film capacitors in DC link significantly reduces capacitor quantity and PCB space. The risk of anti-resonance of paralleled capacitors is influenced by equivalent series resistance (ESR) and stray inductance, and can be prevented when the ESRof the electrolytic capacitor is higher than the anti-resonant characteristic impedance.

articleTitle: Si3N4 Substrate Metallization
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: The wide bandgap power devices with the junction temperature up to 200deg C are expected to play a much bigger role in the next decades, especially in the high-power traction inverter and mid-power converter applications. The higher junction temperature is challenging the already existing packaging material. The higher thermal conductivity ceramic substrate is a key material to package the wide bandgap power devices. The metalized Si3N4 substrate is the best candidate material. The two kinds of the process of Si3N4 substrate metallization are compared.

articleTitle: New Transfer Molded Power Integrated Module (TMPIM) for Industrial Drive
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: As latest power devices like SiC MOSFET and 7th generation IGBT continue to improve the efficiency along with power density, it becomes a challenge for power packaging to dissipate the heat from already much miniaturized chips and protect them from high temperature high voltage and humid environment. Thus, we introduce the transfer molded technology (TMPIM) based module packaging. This module encapsulates the power devices with epoxy molding compound thru transfer molding process. Com-pared to conventional gel filled module, it demonstrates much improved temperature cycling perfor-mance and extended module lifetime. It also achieves a low thermal resistance and high-power module density by adopting thick copper advanced substrate instead of baseplate. In the meantime, the manu-facturing process of TMPIM is much simplified and robust. It is a great fit for applications which seek for fully utilizing the strength of IGBT and SiC semiconductor in high reliability, power density, and robust-ness.

articleTitle: Effect of Fatigue Crack Network in Die-attach Joints on Thermal Resistance
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: We evaluated the effect of fatigue crack networks in die-attach joints on the thermal resistance Rth and found singular rise of Rth in the final phase of fatigue crack networks formation. Structure of samples was Si/Solder/Si joints, and Sn-based lead-free solder alloys were used for the die-attach materials. We conducted thermal cycling tests and measured Rth, vertical crack density and thickness of die-attach joints before/after the tests. Then, we calculated rise of Rth due to vertical cracks and found that increase of measured Rth became twice larger than calculated one in the final phase of fatigue crack networks formation. Horizontal cracks were observed in cross-sections of a severely damaged sample in addition to vertical cracks, and this caused remarkable rise of Rth.

articleTitle: An ANPC converter design using ST20 for high-power offshore wind application
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: In order to pursuit lower system cost and higher energy efficiency, power of single wind turbine is becoming higher and higher. For offshore wind application, 8~10MW wind turbine is becoming a common practice. To address this demanding market, power modules with higher power density are needed. This paper presents a high reliable power module named ST20 which is designed by Semikron and very suitable for offshore wind converters because of its unparalleled design, such as low stray inductance, high current capability, excellent current sharing of module paralleling and easy DC-link connection. This paper also illustrates the benefits of ANPC topology for high power application, and investigates the feasibility of ST20 module used in an ANPC 10MW converter by simulation study. Furthermore, a 3-level reference design helps to illustrate that ST20 module is an excellent solution for high power offshore wind application with improved reliability.

articleTitle: A benchmark study on the AC voltage in the 3L converter for high power offshore wind turbines
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper introduces the latest trends in power converters in offshore wind turbines and analyses the influence of different interconnection grid voltages. A benchmark analysis was performed using three types of IGBT modules for various grid voltage classes that are compatible with the same mechanical design, in a unified converter cabinet. A detailed simulation model was also built including package equivalent resistance that can help get more accurate power loss, system efficiency and temperature rise. These benchmark results are more meaningful in real system designs. An 1800 Vac is proposed as the new grid interconnection voltage in this paper. It can be realized with the latest 2300 V IGBT half-bridge module in a neutral point clamped three-level topology. This voltage class shows a lot of benefits in improving power losses and system efficiency. It also increases power density and reduces system costs.

articleTitle: Trench IGBT with FS2 Technology Platform for Low Loss and High Robustness Applications
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: In this paper, trench insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) with field stop 2 (FS2) technology platform is first time demonstrated by Nexperia. FS2 technology is proposed and developed to cover a wide range of switching frequency with high efficiency and robustness. In medium speed scope [20kHz or less], the device with the current and voltage ratings of 40A and 1200V, respectively exhibits a remarkable 20% total loss reduction in terms of On-state and switch losses comparing with state-of-the-art products on the market. In high-speed application [20-40kHz], it features more robustness, while keeps similar trade-off performance between Vcesat and Eoff when compared to state-of-the-art products.

articleTitle: A SiC Based high efficiency high power Three-Phase Interleaved LLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper presents a SiC MOSFET-based 30kW three-phase interleaved LLC resonant converter with high efficiency, high power density and wide output voltage range. It is a good fit for Electric Vehicle (EV) fast charger, High Voltage Direct Current system (HVDC) and other high power DC/DC systems. A flexible gain control scheme of the three-phase LLC resonant converter is studied. A digital controlled prototype with a switching frequency range of 135kHz-250kHz is demonstrated with 200Vdc-1000Vdc output voltage range, 6.5kW/L power density and exceeding 98% in peak efficiency.

articleTitle: Application Benefits of 3.3 kV/185 A, 375 A Full SiC Power Modules
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: High voltage power modules in a railcar traction system are required to reduce power loss and size. To satisfy these requirements, a 3.3 kV Full silicon carbide (SiC) power module has been developed for a railcar traction system. Also, 3.3 kV/185 A, 375 A Full SiC power modules have been developed mainly for auxiliary power converters or small size traction inverters. The new 3.3 kV Full SiC power module can achieve 1.5 to 2.5 times switching frequency and 50% to 75% power loss compared to the latest Si power module even with a smaller current rating. 3.3 kV Full SiC power module offers 175 deg C operation, thus higher power cycling capability is required. The new 3.3 kV Full SiC power module perfectly meets this requirement with around 2.5 times power cycling capability as Si devices.

articleTitle: Automatic optimization of motor controller with component arrangement, disassembly and thermal management
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper presents a genetic algorithm based design method of automatic optimization of motor controller. It describes the realization of automatic arrangement of component and thermal management. This method can be used to design a prototype fast and provides a new optimization path for the design of motor controller system.

articleTitle: Four-stage Deadbeat Control with Dead-time Compensation Based on PMSM
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: With the advancement of science and technology, the control strategies of permanent magnet synchronous motors are becoming more and more diverse. For surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), based on the four-stage deadbeat control strategy, deadtime compensation is introduced. First, the fast vector selection method is used to determine the first optimal vector and the sector where it is located, and then the second optimal vector is selected by the method of current prediction, and the action time of the two optimal vectors and the zero vector is calculated at the same time, effectively reduce computational difficulty and system complexity. The action time of each zero vector is consistent. Secondly, in order to reduce the switching frequency, the zero vector is allocated to the beginning and the end of the control period, and the optimal vector is sorted according to the zero vector. On this basis, dead-time compensation is performed, and finally failed to verify the effectiveness and advancement of the method through simulation.

articleTitle: Microgrid Reliability Assessment Based on Historical Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: Microgrid technology is helpful for the power grid to accept distributed generation (DG), and improve the power supply quality and reliability of the network. Power converters in microgrid are the core devices for connecting various forms of energy. In this paper, the reliability of microgrid is analyzed based on the lifetime estimation of power electronic devices. Among them, the historical weather data is used to analyze the output and power loss of various forms of DG generation. Based on the power loss and the established IGBT thermoelectric model, the junction temperature curve is obtained, and finally the reliability of the converter in the microgrid is analyzed according to the junction temperature.

articleTitle: Pin electrical resistance welding capability and verification of new TO-247 PLUS discrete package
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: Discrete semiconductors connected in parallel for high-power density solutions and design scalability have been adopted in many application scenarios. Key challenges to these solutions are increasing production efficiency and high currentcarrying capacity, and reducing the heat dissipation at the pins caused by heavy load current with liquid cooling. Jointly connecting discrete pins and copper busbars is one effective way of tackling these issues. This is done by resistance-welding technology. Owing to the different melting points on package surfaces, the metal-to-metal welding profile must be qualified for the discrete package and the relevant production process. This paper demonstrates the resistance welding capability of the pins in the TO-247 PLUS discrete package, and validates the reliable joint connection between the discrete pins and the copper busbar to flow the current through. It also includes an analysis of the cross-section and intermetallic compound (IMC) layer that was further enhanced to achieve the qualified welding profile of this new package.

articleTitle: Suppression of vibration and common-mode voltage of dual three-phase motor under improved PWM methods
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: The variable switching frequency modulation can effectively reduce the harmonic peak value of the inverter output current, thereby reducing the mechanical vibration and noise of the motor. Among these strategies, random pulse width modulation (RPWM) is a traditional and effective variable switching frequency modulation method, and its frequency change is completely random. It can effectively reduce high-frequency current harmonics and vibration. As an improved period modulation method, Uniform Distributed Pulse Width Modulation (UDPWM) is preferred to reduce the current total harmonic distortion (THD). For the dual three-phase motors, reverse winding pulse width modulation (RWPWM) can theoretically eliminate common-mode voltage (CMV). In this paper, the novel RW-RPWM and RW-UDPWM are proposed by combining the above PWM methods, which can achieve the suppression of both CMV and vibration. Among them, RW-RPWM has better vibration reduction performance, and RWUDPWM has less influence on current THD.

articleTitle: Design of Portable Power Quality Detection Device Based on DSP+ARM
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: The requirements for data processing capability, operation efficiency and safe operation of portable power quality detection devices are getting higher and higher, and traditional power quality detection devices based on single-core ARM and DSP can no longer meet the requirements. Design the scheme of DSP and ARM dual-core portable power quality detection device. The DSP core is responsible for completing the collection of power quality data and the storage of the computing core; the ARM core is responsible for completing the display of power quality data and sending it to the host computer; the SYSLINK module is responsible for Complete the data transmission between the DSP core and the ARM core; on this basis, the rapid update of the voltage/current RMS method is used to improve the data detection accuracy, and the big data technology is used to improve the accuracy of the state monitoring of power quality information. [Result] The hardware and software design of portable power quality detection device was completed. The accuracy, efficiency and feasibility of the device are verified by testing parameter accuracy test, data processing ability test and dynamic power quality testing test.

articleTitle: Comparison of CCM and CRM Totem-Pole PFC based on Silicon Carbide Device
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: High efficiency and high power density are the two most important trend for high performance Switching-mode AC/DC converter system. Sillicon Carbide (SiC) device which has extremely small reverse-recovery loss makes the simplest bridgeless topology totem-pole Power Factor Correction (PFC) a preferred solution. In this paper, the key technology and design of Continuous Current Mode (CCM) and Critical Current Mode (CRM) Totem-pole PFC are reviewed. The system loss calculation method based on device Double Pulse Test is proposed, the loss distribution and volume of the main components are compared. Based on the comparison, the CRM Totem-pole PFC is the preferred choice to achieve both high efficiency and power density at a higher cost.

articleTitle: Improving speed and power density of electrical machines through regional changes in properties of electrical steels
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: Increasing the power density of a motor by increasing its speed is a feasible and attractive method. When designing high-speed motors, it is always necessary to take into account the mechanical strength of the rotor, as the high centrifugal force of the rotor at high speeds can lead to rotor cracking. Therefore, for rotors, such as interior permanent-magnet synchronous rotors and synchronous reluctance rotors, which have flux bridges to withstand the centrifugal forces of rotors, wider flux bridges are required as the speed increases. However, wider flux bridge may result in higher flux leakage and lower torque. The power density of the motor might not increase. This paper proposes new ways to increase the mechanical strength and reduce the flux leakage of the synchronous rotors. Improvements to the motor are evaluated and techniques for obtaining the required magnetic materials are illustrated.

articleTitle: 20A/600V RC-IGBT Based Transfer Molded IPM for Home Appliance Application
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: This paper presents a new large rating current product in SLIMDIPTM series with part No. SLIMDIP-X. Thermal resistance between chip and case Rth(j-c) is reduced approximately 35% lower than conventional SLIMDIP-L (15A/600V). The new 20A/600V reverse-conducting IGBT (RC-IGBT) and the insulation sheet enable this lower thermal resistance. As a result, the allowable output current of inverter system becomes 18% higher than the system adopting SLIMDIP-L. Furthermore, EMI radiation noise is also improved in SLIMDIP-X by new RC-IGBT chip, which enables to reduce the number of noise suppression components and then will lead to smaller and lower-cost inverter system.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Current Control of Open-winding PMSM Based on Zero Sequence Current Suppression
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: A hybrid three-vector model predictive current control (MPCC) for open winding permanent magnet synchronous motor (OW-PMSM) is proposed in this paper. The fast voltage-vector selection method is used to select one non-zero voltage vector to act on inverter1 (INV1) in each control period. Then, inverter2 (INV2) adopts the voltage vectors selection method that considers the zero sequence voltage layering, according to the layering of the zero sequence voltage reference value and the magnitude of the plane reference voltage of the alphabeta-axes, the range of candidate voltage vectors can be narrowed and the calculation amount of the control process can be reduced. At the same time, the action time of voltage vector (VV) is calculated by using the deadbeat of the dqaxes current, and the optimal voltage vectors of inverter2 (INV2) are selected by adding the value function of the zero sequence current (ZSC) error term, which effectively suppresses the zero sequence current (ZSC), and improves the steadystate control effect of the system. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Short Circuit Protection of SiC MOSFET Module with Extended Short Circuit Withstanding Time
publicationTitle: PCIM Asia 2022; International Exhibition and Conference for Power Electronics, Intelligent Motion, Renewable Energy and Energy Management
abstract: The short circuit protection of SiC MOSFETs is one of the most critical challenges that need to be overcome for these devices to be widely deployed in power converters. This paper proposes a centralized two-step protection method to achieve fast and noise-immune protection during the short circuit. Firstly, the short circuit current that returns to the bus capacitor is detected and the gate driving voltage is reduced to a lower value to increase the short-circuit withstanding time. Secondly, the phase leg output voltage is sensed and corresponded with a pre-set range to further verify the short-circuit fault. If confirmed, an error signal is generated to turn off the power devices. Compared with state-of-art protection methods which locally turn off the power device, the proposed method features centralized protection, ultra-fast response, and high noise immunity capability. Experimental results confirm the excellent performance of the proposed protection scheme.
